notes.title: First Major Update - World 6 Added!
notes.content:
The journey of [i]Lost & Round[/i] has just begun! With the first major update added to the game, players can expect new and devious levels to kick off the start of Chapter 2. Explore World 6: The Neonosphere and traverse the dark and dreamy Neozone to grab one more Megapixel on your journey. With the addition of +10 more levels, the current price for [i]Lost & Round[/i] will be increased to $5.99 USD to reflect the level of content currently available in-game. Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed my little game so far, and I am excited to bring this and future updates to the Community!

One Love,
-Jimmy (Open Sky Studios)

notes.title: Lost & Round - First Patch Released!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased [i]Lost & Round[/i] so far--your support means the world to me! Thanks to the excellent feedback of some early players, the following features have been implemented:

[olist]
[*] Ability to skip the Intro cutscene has been added.
[*] Additional options for rotating the camera with Q and E keys.
[*] Dialog can now be advanced with the F key (or the Continue button).
[/olist]
[b]Bug Note:[/b] I am aware of a UI issue with the Yes/No buttons on the 'New Game' screen. I have listed a workaround in-game and am in search of a fix!

notes.title: Lost & Round Now in BETA!
notes.content:
To everyone that has shown interest in playing my little game so far, a huge thank you! I just wanted to update the Community with some great news: [i]Lost & Round[/i] will move to an Early Access release before the summer begins! As I put the final touches on the first chapter of the game (and sqush some pesky bugs), I am gathering invaluable feedback from a small group of Beta testers. Those excited to follow Io's journey can keep an eye out for a launch in the next week or two with a fun little discount thrown in. :)

One love,
Open Sky Studios (~Jimmy)
